qualification: Retain a preparation- and context-specific exploratory muscle-performance comparator. Controlled positives and decrements coexist; no BUBR1 restoration, MVA efficacy or head-to-head superiority is established.

identity.same_molecule_not_same_intervention: Preserve manufacturer, coingredients, nutritional comparator, exercise state and timing in each trial. The current older-muscle registry does not independently verify the final administered product.
excluded_equivalences: Beta-hydroxybutyrate salts and their counterions/enantiomer mixtures
identity.regimen_boundary: Study exposures are source descriptors, not a proposed pediatric or MVA regimen.

studies.source_version: 20-page Early View publisher PDF; Creative Commons Attribution notice and DOI verified; obtained from a public mirror, checked against publisher HTML.

design.type: Pair-matched randomized, double-blind, parallel-group training comparison
design.dropouts: One participant from each arm did not complete because of illness during the experimental period.
design.randomized_count: 30 total / 15 per arm is supported by the entered count, randomization description and one post-allocation withdrawal per group; this is a reconstruction, not a separately displayed allocation-flow denominator. Do not label 28 as the number originally randomized.
design.analysis_population: Completers; no intention-to-treat sensitivity analysis identified.
design.population: Trained young men, eligibility 18–35 years, regular cycling, VO2peak screening >50 mL/kg/min; no chronic-weakness cohort.
design.allocation: Pair-matched on familiarized TT performance, split by researcher not conducting experimental measurements; exact sequence-generation/concealment details limited.
design.blinding: Nontransparent tubes; bitter comparator. At end, 7/14 CON and 8/14 KE identified assignment correctly.
design.duration: 8 weeks; PRE, week 3 MID, week 7 POST, week 8 after taper.

preparation.active: Pure (R)-3-hydroxybutyl (R)-3-hydroxybutyrate, purchased from KetoneAid Inc.; numeric purity/batch assay not supplied.
preparation.control: 16.4 g pure medium-chain triglycerides plus 1 mM bitter sucrose octaacetate in a 25 g control drink.
preparation.energy: 489 kJ per 25 g drink in each condition.
preparation.timing: Reported 25 g immediately after each training session and 30 min before sleep; first training day excepted for baseline sleep recording. Post-exercise intake supervised. Weekly bags/empty returns for other doses. Main mentions non-training-day supplements without a fully explicit off-day clock schedule; do not invent one. Discussion describes 50–75 g/day.
preparation.common_nutrition: About 60 g carbohydrate/hour during sessions >1 h; common recovery shake 64 g carbohydrate plus 30 g protein five minutes post-training; standardized test meals.
preparation.interpretation: Monoester versus an isocaloric MCT nutritional comparator under supervised training; not an inert placebo contrast, generic ketone class test or dosing recommendation.

primary_outcomes: Change in mean power output during a 30 min cycling time trial
Change in capillarization of the musculus vastus lateralis
registration.judgment: Accessible official registration is retrospective relative to primary completion. TT is one of four registered primary outcomes, not sole prospectively verified primary.
registration.history_limit: Current official API record and its first/last dates read; archived version-by-version history and a pre-study protocol not independently obtained.

function_outcomes.name: 30-min mean cycling power at week 7
function_outcomes.interpretation: Direct reported between-group functional contrast; about4% higher after training.

function_outcomes.name: Peak power in VO2peak test, PRE-to-POST change
function_outcomes.interpretation: Improvement difference positive; do not relabel final absolute peak power as a significant group difference.

function_outcomes.name: Relative VO2peak PRE-to-POST change
function_outcomes.interpretation: Physiological capacity positive; baseline relative VO2peak differs (PRE p=.028), so retain change contrast and baseline imbalance.

other_results.training_load: No group-time interaction p=.122 or group effect p=.398; equal workload is a reported null, not proof of exact exposure equivalence.
other_results.body_composition: No treatment-by-time effect on body composition; lean mass increased with training across groups, not a demonstrated added monoester hypertrophy effect.
other_results.stress_recovery: No group-time differences in stress-recovery state p=.811, total stress p=.723 or recovery p=.891.
other_results.cardiac: No group-time effect for peak cardiac output p=.334 or stroke volume p=.428; no direct added cardiac adaptation.
other_results.biochemistry: CS activity between-group POST contrast positive p=.035 and group-time p<.001. Complex II interaction p=.036, with KE within-arm increase 25%,p=.030; not separately reported significant absolute post KE-CON protein contrast. PGC1alpha increased similarly; SIRT3 and acetylation null.
other_results.metabolomics: 57 analytes; ketone-related interactions and citric-acid contrast arose only without multiple-testing correction. Do not promote uncorrected citrate result to confirmed mechanism.
other_results.mechanism_boundary: No causal mediation analysis or direct maximal mitochondrial respiratory-capacity assay here. CS/SDH are markers; last training bout and biopsy timing may contribute. No BUB1B/BUBR1 or chromosome-fidelity intervention assay.

analysis.reported: Repeated-measures group-by-time ANOVA; Sidak post hoc. Missing cardiac data via mixed model. Metabolomics BH-FDR and Bonferroni post hoc. TT-focused sample-size calculation, 14/group.
limits: Small completer cohort; male-only trained population
Retrospective registration with multiple registered primary outcomes; no family-wide primary-outcome correction identified
Exact role of matched pairs in final covariance model not fully specified; published estimates retained without independent reanalysis
No raw-data paired or intention-to-treat reconstruction performed

harms.dropouts: One illness-related noncompletion per arm; diagnoses/causality not given.
harms.training_interruptions: Four participants per arm missed >=1 session for illness/injury; five CON and four KE had reduced training intensity for fatigue.
harms.cardiac_observation: No arrhythmias detected at rest/during exercise; cardiac strain and adaptation measures did not suggest adverse change over8 weeks.
harms.limit: No comprehensive prospective adverse-event table or GI-symptom denominator identified. Author statement of good tolerability cannot establish broad safety.

funding_conflicts.study: FWO G089221N and KU Leuven internal C14/21/092.
funding_conflicts.author_support: CP:FWO1244921N/12B0E24N; YB:FWO-TBM T004420N; KT:EACVI research grant2021.

source_reporting_gaps.source: Methods p6 excludes 3 KE/2 CON for peak output/stroke volume, while Table2p14 caption says 13 per arm. Outcome-specific counts unresolved; TT figure remains 14 per arm.
Results p11 uses micromol per hour/kg protein, whereas Figure3 axis and abstract use mol per hour/kg protein. Direction and statistical contrast preserved; exact biochemical units unqualified.
Figure1 axis TR1/TR14/TR38 differs from caption/body TR7/TR16/TR43; Table3 KE middle column says week 2 versus Methods/CONweek 3. Do not silently resolve.

access_gaps: Linked appendix and peer-review files returned403 or web access errors; not read
Archived registry history/pre-study protocol unavailable in current bounded packet
studies.conclusion: Retain a controlled, modest, context-specific training-performance positive for this monoester. Prospective hierarchy and supplementary/reporting gaps limit certainty; no MVA or generic ketone efficacy transfer.

studies.source_version: Complete Europe PMC primary XML from retained lead source; byte-identical local copy.

design.type: Randomized double-blind four-period crossover, two factors (ketone and bicarbonate)
design.participants: Main recruitment, power calculation and figure captions all say 12 highly trained men; abstract says 14.
design.denominator_gap: Unresolved source disagreement, not demonstrated 14 enrolled/12 completed attrition.
design.sequence: Stratified random order based on familiarization TT output; same time of day.
design.outcome: 60 min standardized warm-up;30 min time trial; subsequent all-out 175% lactate-threshold sprint.

preparation.active: (R)-3-hydroxybutyl (R)-3-hydroxybutyrate, TdeltaS Ltd; total 50 g in two equal portions at warm-up minutes 30 and 55. Numeric purity unreported.
preparation.control: Taste/volume/viscosity-matched 12.5% w/v collagen-peptan plus 1 mM bitter sucrose octaacetate; isocaloric matching not established.
preparation.cofactor: Bicarbonate 180 mg/kg across capsules/drinks; non-bicarbonate conditions received equimolar-sodium NaCl control.
preparation.common_nutrition: Standardized carbohydrate-rich dinner/breakfast and 60 g carbohydrate during warm-up in all conditions.
preparation.scope: Source descriptors only; no regimen advice; supplier/vehicle/timing differs from training trial despite same ester molecule.

primary_effect.estimand: Within-person ketone main effect: mean(KE,KE+BIC) minus mean(CON,BIC)
primary_effect.interpretation: Do not relabel this factorial estimate as a separately established ketone-only versus placebo pairwise estimate; do not count four arms as independent subjects.

other_function.sprint_estimand: Bicarbonate main effect: mean(BIC,KE+BIC) minus mean(CON,KE)
other_function.sprint_outlier: One time-to-exhaustion outlier removed using ROUT 1%; exact condition not specified in main.
other_function.boundary: Sprint benefit belongs to bicarbonate factorial contrast, not a ketone benefit.

analysis_and_interactions.methods: Two-way repeated-measures KE-by-BIC ANOVA for single-time outcomes; time-by-KE-by-BIC repeated-measures ANOVA for longitudinal measures. Geisser-Greenhouse if needed; Bonferroni post hoc after significant interaction.
analysis_and_interactions.primary_design: Main identifies TT mean power as primary in its sample-size paragraph; no prospectively archived trial protocol/registry qualified.
analysis_and_interactions.interpretation: Performance section reports ketone main effect and bicarbonate sprint main effect, but no numeric KE-by-BIC performance interaction estimate/p/CI. Author independence wording does not establish zero interaction.
analysis_and_interactions.metabolic_interaction: A time-by-KE-by-BIC interaction for blood betaHB is reported p=.02; bicarbonate raises ketone concentration. This physiological interaction is not the performance interaction.

harms_and_mechanism.GI: Overall low symptom scores but ketone main effect p=.01: KE 12 ± 12, KE+BIC 11 ± 9, CON 7 ± 12, BIC 5 ± 8 on 96-point scale; dizziness/upper-abdominal symptoms contribute.
harms_and_mechanism.acid_base: KE lowers pH/bicarbonate; co-bicarbonate counteracts measured acidosis without improving the reported pooled ketone TT effect.
harms_and_mechanism.causality: GI symptoms may contribute to output; blood lactate changes do not establish glycogen sparing or a single mechanism.
harms_and_mechanism.blinding: None identified all four conditions correctly; 9/12 identified their best performance trial.
harms_and_mechanism.safety_limit: Acute small healthy sample; no clinical/MVA safety claim.

funding_conflicts.funding: Research Fund Flanders G080117N and Flemish Ministry of Sport/Sport Vlaanderen.

access_gaps: Full article PDF and raw individual dataset not obtained; full XML and all four native main figures are now available and read.
No exact direct KE-only versus CON confidence interval or P value reconstructed from the plot.
studies.conclusion: A same-molecule acute high-intensity performance counterexample, with a small adverse within-person factorial estimate; not a direct test of the chronic post-exercise training strategy.

native_figure_update.access: Public Europe PMC supplementaryFiles ZIP supplies original main figures 1–4, not a new supplementary outcome dataset.
native_figure_update.result: Figure 4B confirms the pooled ketone effect; Figure 4E confirms the pooled bicarbonate effect. Figure 4C graphically displays a KE-only versus CON 95% CI crossing zero; no exact endpoints or pairwise P inferred.
native_figure_update.mechanism: Figures 2 and 3 show bicarbonate alters circulating ketones as well as acid–base measures; acid–base causality is not isolated.
native_figure_update.reading: Independent reviewer inspected all four native figures; root inspected Figures 3 and 4 and their full XML captions.

source.title: Acute ketone supplementation in the absence of muscle glycogen utilization: Insights from McArdle disease
source.scientific_depth: Complete primary abstract only; full main, native tables/figures and supplements not obtained.

design.reported: Randomized crossover; submaximal constant-load test followed by maximal ramp test after placebo or acute ketone ester. Patients additionally assessed after carbohydrate.
design.denominator_limit: Abstract reports n=8/7 but provides no flow or endpoint denominators. Do not independently certify that every endpoint includes all participants.
design.patient_healthy_status: Disease-versus-healthy comparison is between populations, not a randomized disease assignment.
design.CHO_arm: 75 g carbohydrate tested in patients only; carbohydrate source, allocation/order relative to placebo/ketone and third-condition crossover structure not independently verified.
design.paired_analysis: Within-participant treatment comparison implied by crossover; statistical pairing method cannot be verified.
design.carryover_period_sequence_analysis: Unknown; no claim that carryover was absent.

preparation.ketone: 30 g D-beta-hydroxybutyrate/D-1,3-butanediol monoester, as named in abstract
preparation.boundary: Specific acute monoester exposure, not ketogenic diet, ketone salts, calcium/sodium pyruvate, or an interchangeable ketone class; not regimen advice.

outcomes.name: Maximal ramp-test peak power output
outcomes.contrast: Ketone ester versus placebo in crossover
outcomes.n: 8 patients described in abstract; endpoint-specific analyzed n not independently verified
outcomes.interpretation: Reported adverse controlled functional contrast for this acute preparation in this disease context.

outcomes.name: Maximal ramp-test peak power output
outcomes.contrast: Ketone ester versus placebo in crossover
outcomes.interpretation: No statistically significant effect reported; not proof of equivalence or universal absence of benefit.

outcomes.name: Maximal ramp-test peak power output
outcomes.interpretation: Reported carbohydrate advantage over ketone condition; full order/pairing details unavailable.

outcomes.name: Maximal ramp-test peak power output
outcomes.interpretation: Positive point estimate but no conventional statistical superiority established in this comparison. Do not inherit the abstract conclusion as a significant placebo comparison.

outcomes.name: Peak power output disease-versus-healthy comparison
outcomes.interpretation: Cross-population capacity difference, not a ketone treatment effect.

outcomes.name: Blood ketones
outcomes.interpretation: Ketosis/biochemical engagement in all participants, not functional benefit.

outcomes.name: Gas exchange
outcomes.reported: Some responses changed, notably increased respiratory exchange ratio, especially in patients
outcomes.interpretation: Physiological change; not an independent claim of improved function.

critical_boundaries.interaction: Patient P=.001 and control P=.268 do not establish a disease-by-treatment interaction. Interaction statistic/P/CI not available; differential treatment response remains unverified.
critical_boundaries.effect_scale: Retain published percent differences as reported. Absolute paired differences, denominator used for each percent, individual trajectories and precision unavailable; do not reconstruct unreported effect sizes from these percentages.
critical_boundaries.clinical_scope: McArdle disease prevents use of muscle glycogen; this result does not establish MVA harm or general ketone-class failure.
critical_boundaries.carbohydrate: Preserve the positive point estimate and significant versus-ketone contrast, without promoting P=.057 versus placebo to established superiority.

harms.attribution: No harms/tolerance detail in abstract. Absence of a harms summary is not evidence of no adverse events. Lower task power is the reported functional outcome, not proof of general clinical toxicity.

primary_metadata_pointers.citation: Løkken et al. 2022, No effect of oral ketone ester supplementation on exercise capacity in patients with McArdle disease and healthy controls
primary_metadata_pointers.depth: Cited-reference metadata only; cohort not reappraised.

primary_metadata_pointers.citation: Valenzuela et al., Dose–response effect of pre-exercise carbohydrates under muscle glycogen unavailability: insights from McArdle disease
primary_metadata_pointers.depth: Cited-reference metadata/title pointer only; no patient mapping.

cohort_ancestry_and_overlap.interpretation: Neither citations, shared investigators nor different publications establish independence or overlap. Participant identities/genotypes/site timelines unavailable; no summed unique-patient or independent-replication count.
cohort_ancestry_and_overlap.participant_ancestry_and_genotypes: Not described in abstract; author affiliations do not establish ancestry.

funding_and_interests.limit: Do not treat bibliographic funding metadata as complete declarations.

notice_check.scope: No linked correction/retraction found in retained metadata; publisher notice history not fully audited.

studies.decision: Retain an incompletely appraised clinical counterexample; the full main remains unavailable. No MVA or class-wide harm inference.

article.title: Ketone Monoester Increases Skeletal Muscle Power and Energy Turnover in Older but Not Young Men Without Affecting Metabolic Economy: A Controlled, Double Blind, Cross-Over Trial

access.lawful_routes: Wiley full-text/PDF links redirected to abstract; normal public HTML/full-XML and supporting-image requests returned 403. Aarhus and Aalborg institutional records expose abstract/DOI but no deposited full file. ResearchGate search result is request-only; no contact.
access.scope: Stop after normal publisher, institutional and author/OA discovery routes. No bypass, account action or author contact.
access.reliance: Paper outcomes from primary abstract; preparation/protocol details separately attributed to current registry. Public supporting captions are methodological pointers, not inspected images.

cohort.population: Healthy men, matched by age-adjusted VO2max; not a frailty, myopathy or MVA cohort.
cohort.registry_eligibility: BMI 19–27, stable weight and less than three 60-minute structured-exercise sessions per week; exclusions include metabolism-altering medication and disease affecting exercise.
cohort.missingness: The current registry enrollment of 25 versus abstract total of 24 is unresolved. Do not invent an exclusion/withdrawal or use 12/12 as verified n for every endpoint; the public S3 enrollment image could not be obtained.

preparation.paper_abstract: Ketone monoester versus placebo; low-dose continuous glucose infusion on both days to inhibit endogenous ketogenesis.
preparation.current_registry_vehicle_and_control: Volume-, calorie- and taste-matched lipid-emulsion placebo; blood ketones maintained with a sipping protocol.
preparation.cointervention: Continuous low-dose glucose infusion in both conditions; this is not a ketone-alone fasting contrast.
unknowns: Measured ketone exposure and protocol adherence
preparation.boundary: Registry naming does not independently verify the final administered product or justify transfer to salts, diesters, free precursors or other commercial products.

design.current_registry: Two study days, randomized order, participant/investigator masking, at least four weeks apart; fasted visits with controlled prior diet/activity.
design.masking_success: Public Figure S2 caption identifies a treatment-certainty assessment, but its numerical results/image were inaccessible.
design.registered_primary_current: Work efficiency: external ankle dorsiflexion work per ATP consumed, measured by dynamometer and 31P-MRS.
design.other_registered_current: Oxidative capacity, ATP generation, mitochondrial function, intramuscular pH, tibialis anterior fatigue, blood measures, and cycling-related measures.
design.registration_timing: Current record actual start 2022-12-22; first submitted 2023-01-17 and first posted 2023-02-17. Abstract says pre-registered, but pre-enrollment registration is not established by these dates.
design.registry_history: Not audited; current record updated 2026-03-06 after publication. No posted results (hasResults=false). Prospective fixed endpoint hierarchy not independently verified.
design.registry_protocol_amendment: Current description limits fixed-intensity cycling to young participants because older participants had difficulty completing it. This is not an observed ketone adverse-effect finding; broader registered cycling results are not supplied by the article abstract.

outcomes.name: Peak muscle power
outcomes.young: No increase reported in abstract conclusion
outcomes.boundary: Absolute versus volume-normalized effect not verified; no inference about maximal isometric force or daily mobility.

outcomes.name: Time-torque-derived work capacity
outcomes.young: No increase reported in abstract conclusion
outcomes.boundary: Time-torque integral is not interchangeable with mechanical work in joules. Public S1 caption distinguishes concentric work, TTI and their economy metrics; positive abstract statement does not establish every absolute or normalized work metric.

outcomes.name: ATP production
outcomes.young: No increase reported in abstract conclusion
outcomes.interpretation: Biochemical/energetic response; increased ATP turnover is not improved ATP economy.

outcomes.name: Metabolic economy
outcomes.age_comparison: Older group lower economy than young
outcomes.hierarchy: Corresponds to current registered primary work-efficiency construct
outcomes.boundary: Primary economy null is retained; no equivalence conclusion.

outcomes.name: Relative decline in peak power
outcomes.boundary: Preserve reduced relative power retention/increased relative fatigability as a tradeoff. Higher initial peak can influence this relative metric; absolute final power, functional harm and mechanism cannot be inferred.

outcomes.name: Contraction-induced intramuscular pH decline
outcomes.boundary: Do not convert local contraction-induced acidification into evidence of systemic ketoacidosis or a clinical adverse event.

outcomes.name: Oxidative capacity
outcomes.result: Similar between age groups and unaffected by ketones
outcomes.method: 31P-MRS/phosphocreatine recovery according to abstract and registry

outcomes.name: Complex I+II respiration
outcomes.result: Lower in older than young, with no ketone effect
outcomes.boundary: Age difference is not a ketone-induced mitochondrial impairment.

age_interaction.available_model_description: S1 public caption describes treatment-group-time interactions with day/order fixed effects and participant/participant-day random effects.
age_interaction.boundary: A model containing an interaction is not a significant interaction result. Older-group significance and young-group nonsignificance alone do not prove age-specific treatment response; no direct age-interaction estimate/P or CI is available.

studies.harms: GI symptoms, other adverse events, dropouts and severity/attribution cannot be verified. Greater power decline and pH decline are measured performance/physiological tradeoffs, not a complete clinical safety assessment.

publisher_crossref_funders.name: A.P. Møller og Hustru Chastine Mc-Kinney Møllers Fond til almene Formaal

funding_and_conflicts.limits: Full funding/funder-role and product-supply statements inaccessible. No commercial conflict is inferred merely from the brand in the registry.

studies.BUB1B_MVA: No BUB1B/BUBR1 restoration or MVA efficacy established by the accessible study material. Useful local human-function observations should not be discarded solely because no BUBR1 assay is available, but transfer to MVA is unproven.

notice_check.limit: No linked notice identified in these metadata records; no full publisher Crossmark history audit.

studies.decision: Retain local-muscle function positives, nulls and fatigue/pH tradeoffs as incomplete evidence; no verified age interaction or MVA transfer.

studies.selection: Earlier controlled positive retained as contextual lead, not preaccepted
studies.design: Randomized-order blinded crossover; n=8 (6 men, 2 women), not the paper-wide 39.
studies.preparation: (R)-3-hydroxybutyl (R)-3-hydroxybutyrate monoester (reported >99.8% purity), 40% calories plus dextrose, versus isocaloric mixed carbohydrates; carbohydrate composition/amount differ.
studies.context: Overnight fast, one-hour fixed cycling then 30-minute distance time trial.
studies.analysis: Paired two-sided t test; study-five power calculation described.
studies.interests: Patent/royalty and TdeltaS relationships declared; DARPA and UK Sport funding.
gaps: Carbohydrate contrast prevents isolating added ketone with carbohydrate held equal
No biopsy in study five; metabolic studies are separate
studies.reading_depth: Cambridge 74-page combined manuscript retained; targeted study-five result/design/supplement/statistics and conflicts, native Figure 7 page45 inspected. No whole-paper full appraisal.
independent_source_inconsistencies: Figure 7 caption calls F a percent comparison and G a Bland–Altman plot; native panels show distance bars and connected paired distances.

Supplement gives a dextrose/fructose/maltodextrin ratio inconsistent with the native Figure 7A calorie split. Use mixed carbohydrates with different composition/amount, not an unambiguous exact ratio.

studies.design: Single-blind randomized parallel comparison; 18 runners, nine per arm; 31 days.
studies.preparation: Same named monoester versus isocaloric flavor-matched placebo; manufacturer, vehicle and final analysis details unqualified.
studies.functional_result: No 5-km time-trial improvement reported. Absolute treatment contrast, confidence interval and equivalence margin unavailable in the abstract.
studies.other_results: Selected cognitive signals and preserved mean absolute exercise oxygen uptake reported; these do not establish running benefit or a VO2peak gain.
studies.gaps: Full main/native outcomes, prospective endpoint hierarchy, multiplicity, detailed harms and participant flow not qualified. Direct publisher access failed; search-index main excerpts are not a full-main appraisal.
studies.reading: Root read complete retained official PubMed abstract; independent reviewer also read the complete abstract. No summed replication or unique-patient count.

bounded_search_result.conclusion: No qualifying intervention identified; not proof of universal absence.

BUB1B_BUBR1.scope: No qualifying BUB1B/BUBR1 intervention identified in the recorded bounded searches or these assessed trials; not proof that none exists anywhere.
BUB1B_BUBR1.transfer: Ketosis, ATP turnover or sports performance cannot substitute for BUBR1 protein/function or chromosome-fidelity measurements.

competitiveness.credit: The training and study-5 performance positives deserve actual-function credit; no mandatory BUBR1 assay is imposed on a compensation route.
competitiveness.limitations: Small trained/healthy cohorts, active nutrition comparators, retrospective primary-outcome registration, acute context-dependent decrements and incomplete clinical/local-muscle reporting prevent an established general muscle-rescue or MVA ranking.
competitiveness.current_decision: Exploratory compensation comparator; niacin/restoration and apitegromab/compensation remain provisional rather than proven superior.
competitiveness.next_discriminating_evidence: A relevant metabolic phenotype and achievable measured exposure, followed by controlled absolute useful-function, renewable-reserve and chromosome-fidelity outcomes in affected/corrected models. Establish BUBR1 mediation additionally only if claiming restoration.
competitiveness.no_cross_trial_ranking: Do not pool watts, distance, local torque integrals and clinical deficits into a common efficacy score.

scope.independent_cohorts: No combined unique-participant or independent-replication count; cited McArdle cohorts and publications may overlap, and no participant mapping was obtained.
scope.raw_data: No individual-level reanalysis or figure digitization.
scope.completeness: Broader compound enumeration, efficacy and source follow-up remain incomplete.

pending_primary_followup.scope: The 2022 ester study is now separately qualified; the three earlier salt reports have bounded lineage review only, with efficacy qualification still incomplete. They are not negative evidence.
pending_primary_followup.next_checks: Actual salt preparation, function and absolute-output contrasts, survival/toxicity, exposure, and known reuse of the 2019 force data in 2021.

root_reading.mcardle: Full retained PubMed abstract/text and qualification, including all reported contrast P values; not full main.
root_reading.andersen: Full retained PubMed abstract; current registry status/design/arms/outcome modules; source qualification. No scientific main or native figures.
root_reading.poffe: Native main Figures 3 and 4 and full XML captions; source and independent qualification/addendum. Not a second complete root XML reading.
root_reading.robberechts: Source and independent qualifications; relies on their separately recorded main/native figure reading, not a new root complete-main pass.
root_reading.cox: Targeted source-qualified contextual lead and independent study-5 check, not a new root whole-paper read.

additional_source_qualification.scope: Separate R,R bolus force signal; S,S and 50:50 R,R/S,S mixture are distinct. No R,R-only infusion experiment, oral sepsis efficacy or MVA benefit established.
